_comment: Sovereign-mesh node/capability registry. DECLARATIVE source of truth for capability-routed federation (research-review docs/99-session-notes/2026-06-29-research-review-sovereign-mesh-two-nas-replication-federation.md). The job router selects the node whose declared `caps` is a superset of a job's `requires`, health-green, cheapest/closest first. DECLARED, NOT GUESSED (DR-0061 reality-trace) and DETERMINISTIC (no LLM in the dispatch decision; the LLM is only the worker on the chosen node). Generalizes the vendor-axis picker in scripts/wake-router.mjs + DR-0073 to a node axis. The two church CUDA towers are NETWORKED LOCAL-CODER WORKERS (Aider + Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:14b), not just inference endpoints: tiered dispatch sends heavy/novel reasoning to vendor Claude and routine/bounded build + transcription + voice to the local towers IN PARALLEL (two towers + home NAS). Honest limit (DR-0076): local coders are weaker on hard reasoning -> well-scoped tasks only; vendor reserved for the hard problems. SHIPS INERT: editing this file does not arm anything; routing still passes through the per-node Cage brakes (infra/ai-orchestrator/portable/orchestrator/lib/brakes.sh) and the mesh kill-switch. Values marked SME-CONFIRM are flagged for Darrell/BG (church hardware, GPU-endpoint IP, church NAS access) per the research-review section 6 — DO NOT fabricate; an SME-CONFIRM cap is treated as OFFLINE by the router until a real value lands.

mesh_kill_switch.note: registry-side mesh-wide kill-switch; UNREACHABLE = treated as ENGAGED (fail closed)

nodes.notes: Verified: Xeon D-1527 4c/8t CPU-only, 32 GB ECC, dual 10 GbE. Runs Caddy poetech-web, n8n, Ollama (CPU), self-hosted Supabase compose. The single authoritative registry/ledger lives here.

nodes.role: sovereign coder worker + gpu (Aider + Ollama coder / voice clone / whisper / local 14B LLM)
nodes.notes: Tower 1 of 2 (1x RTX 4070, an OBS/ProPresenter box on the church LAN — NOT the Synology NAS). Networked LOCAL-CODER WORKER: Aider + Ollama + qwen2.5-coder:14b (the Cage OLLAMA_CODER_MODEL, ~9 GB Q5, fits one 4070 per DR-0012), addressable across Tailscale. Also serves the inference endpoints (real ports per PR #405 / [[project_church_gpu_node]]). SME-CONFIRM the IP only. One large model resident at a time per 12 GB box (DR-0012) -> coder and whisper/voice contend; schedule, do not co-pin. Passive/allowlisted; brakes live on the caller. DR-0012 service-time preemption during Sunday/Wednesday live.

nodes.role: sovereign coder worker + gpu (parallel second tower)
nodes.notes: Tower 2 of 2 — the parallel second local-coder worker (same stack as tower 1). Two towers = two routine build/transcription/voice jobs in parallel + the home NAS. SME-CONFIRM the IP only.

SME-CONFIRM: tlcrackstation (Synology RackStation). On the tailnet but fully firewalled (22/5000/5001/5678/11434/443 filtered, 2026-06-10). Holds the ~100 TB recording corpus (node-local by nature, referenced by ID). Access = a credential/his-hand step (Darrell/BG).

job_classes.note: well-scoped/bounded build tasks -> least-loaded healthy church tower, two towers in parallel; HARD/NOVEL reasoning is NOT this class -> see code-reasoning-hard. Local coders are weaker on hard reasoning: well-scoped only; on a task that proves hard, ESCALATE to vendor, never ship a confident-wrong diff. Same gates (tests/build/guards) apply before trust.
heavy/novel/ambiguous reasoning + cross-cutting design -> vendor Claude (ORCH_MODE vendor-first). Reserved for the hard problems the 14B local coder should not attempt.
private family voice -> church GPU only; if offline, WAITS (never a cloud vendor)
church recordings -> church GPU; private; brakes on the caller queue
non-private heavy gen -> church GPU; vendor fallback only when armed+budgeted+GPU-offline
reconciliation / CPU jobs / deploy-sync -> home DS1621xs
audit ledger / pgvector -> home NAS single instance (no split-brain)
